# Security policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes target the current `main` branch and the latest published moving image
tags. Immutable historical tags are not rebuilt in place.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not open a public issue for suspected vulnerabilities or exposed credentials. Use
GitHub's [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/hambn/tool-containers/security/advisories/new)
and include the affected image or workflow, reproduction details, and the potential
impact. Acknowledgement and remediation timing depend on severity and reproducibility.
